annotation.title_clean: Draft Protocol on Autonomous Weapon Systems (submitted by Argentina, Ecuador, Costa Rica, Nigeria, Panama, the Philippines, Sierra Leone)
annotation.title_en: Draft Protocol on Autonomous Weapon Systems (submitted by Argentina, Ecuador, Costa Rica, Nigeria, Panama, the Philippines, Sierra Leone)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Argentina, Ecuador, Costa Rica, Nigeria, Panama, the Philippines, Sierra Leone
annotation.venue: UN CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS
annotation.summary_en: Draft protocol, submitted by seven states, to regulate autonomous weapon systems. It prohibits systems that violate international humanitarian law, requires meaningful human control across the life cycle, and addresses bias, environmental damage, registration and tracking, weapons review, risk mitigation, compliance, and annual conferences of states parties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prohibits developing, producing, deploying or using autonomous weapons that cannot comply with IHL or distinguish civilians from combatants.
Requires meaningful human control throughout the life cycle, including remote deactivation.
Requires weapons to avoid biased datasets and lasting environmental damage.
Mandates weapons reviews, transparency and registration/tracking for accountability.
Sets up annual conferences of states parties, annual compliance reports and an Implementation Support Unit.
